name: La Habra Youth Committee
org: City of La Habra Community Services
what_you_do: Be a youth leader at city events like La Habra Races and National Night Out. You plan service projects and fun events for local kids. You also learn how city government works.
who_can_apply: Students at local public or private intermediate and high schools. La Habra residents who go to school outside the city or who are home schooled can also apply.
pay_detail: The program page does not mention pay.
duration: August 2026 to May 2027, on a set Tuesday, 5:15 to 6:30 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 deadline was July 9, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Next year's dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Google Form linked on the program page when the next round opens. Questions: Melissa Rivera, 562-383-4200.
notes: This date is from last year. Next year's date is not posted yet. You must go to meetings and can miss no more than two. You must also go to one City Council or Commission meeting. Members are honored at a City Council meeting in June.
